about.body: One Voice 27 brings the Bible, Bible studies, and daily prayer together in one place.\n\nNo sign-in required and no tracking. Your notes and prayer journal stay on your device, and the app works offline once content is downloaded.
about.privacy: The app does not collect any personal data.
about.title: About

bible.addDesc: We accept .yes modules (Alkitab Bible Study), MyBible/MySword SQLite files, and our own .json format. You load the file from your device – it stays in this browser and is never sent to a server.
bible.bookmarksNote: Bookmarks stay in this browser – nothing is sent to a server.
bible.compareOne: Comparison works with one selected verse.
bible.formatsNote: You can build a module from formats that store plain numbered text: Zefania XML, OSIS/USFM, MyBible (SQLite), Alkitab .yes. The file address can point to any server that allows downloads from the browser (CORS). Please respect copyright: many modern translations may be kept for personal use but not redistributed.
